title: Noether R361-R362 Papers 09 and 13-14 source-audit survival no-patch support
scope: R361 covers Paper 09 source pp. 103-128 on the R347 base. R362 covers the combined Paper 13/Paper 14 span from the Paper 13 section heading through immediately before Paper 15, with Paper 14 embedded as a centered source-title block rather than a top-level section anchor.
summary: R361 applies no TeX patch and records that the current R347 Paper 09 span is normalized-identical to the 2026-06-29 WebR271CSI P09 pp.103-128 source-audit closure TeX. R362 applies no TeX patch and records that the current R347 P13/P14 span is normalized-identical to the R344/R341 source-survival span. Both packages are current-base survival closures and should not be used to replace R347 with older Web variants.
caveats: No TeX patch is made by R361 or R362.
R361 does not duplicate all Paper 09 source images; it points to the 2026-06-29 contiguous page-band packages for pp.103-108, 109-114, 115-120, 121-126, and 127-128.
Paper 09 full-page source is mixed native 400/600ppi; split 1000dpi witnesses in the band packages are readability derivatives, not independent native-1000 scans.
Paper 13 is best-staged around 400ppi, and Paper 14 is best-staged around GDZ600; both remain below the preferred native650 full-page certification threshold.

This wave is current-base survival/anti-regression support only, not fresh full source recertification, not Noether closure, not multilingual synchronization, not strict native650/1000 source closure, and not critical-edition material.
